name: cmd_faces_models_download
description: Download Face Model (command `faces.models.download`). Params: {id, acknowledged: true} → {started, from} — fetch a recognition model LightCraft has a pinned address for (see `downloadHost` in the list), in the background over pure-Rust https (lightcraft-fetch). `acknowledged` must be true: the user has been shown the model's terms and accepted them. It is checked against its size and SHA-256, then installed, chosen and switched on by itself; `faces.models.downloads` shows how far it is.
